command:
set -eu
printf 'BOOT_ID='; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
printf 'OS_RELEASE='; . /etc/os-release; printf '%s %s\n' "$ID" "$VERSION_ID"
printf 'KERNEL='; uname -r
printf 'CROND_ACTIVE='; systemctl is-active crond
printf 'CROND_ENABLED='; systemctl is-enabled crond
printf '%s\n' 'CRON_ALLOW_BEGIN'; if [ -e /etc/cron.allow ]; then stat -c 'mode=%a owner=%U group=%G size=%s' /etc/cron.allow; sed -n '1,40p' /etc/cron.allow; else printf 'ABSENT\n'; fi; printf '%s\n' 'CRON_ALLOW_END'
printf '%s\n' 'CRON_DENY_BEGIN'; if [ -e /etc/cron.deny ]; then stat -c 'mode=%a owner=%U group=%G size=%s' /etc/cron.deny; sed -n '1,40p' /etc/cron.deny; else printf 'ABSENT\n'; fi; printf '%s\n' 'CRON_DENY_END'
for u in root opsadmin; do if id "$u" >/dev/null 2>&1; then printf 'USER_%s=present\n' "$u"; id "$u"; else printf 'USER_%s=absent\n' "$u"; fi; done
rpm -q cronie 2>/dev/null || true

command:
set -eu
if ! getent passwd opsadmin >/dev/null; then useradd --create-home --shell /bin/bash opsadmin; fi
tmpfile=$(mktemp /etc/.cron.allow.XXXXXX)
printf '%s\n' root opsadmin > "$tmpfile"
chown root:root "$tmpfile"
chmod 600 "$tmpfile"
mv -f "$tmpfile" /etc/cron.allow
restorecon /etc/cron.allow >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
printf 'configured\n'

set -eu
if ! getent passwd opsadmin >/dev/null; then useradd --create-home --shell /bin/bash opsadmin; fi
tmpfile=$(mktemp /etc/.cron.allow.XXXXXX)
printf '%s\n' root opsadmin > "$tmpfile"
chown root:root "$tmpfile"
chmod 600 "$tmpfile"
mv -f "$tmpfile" /etc/cron.allow
restorecon /etc/cron.allow >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
printf 'configured\n'

set -eu
printf '%s\n' 'CONFIG_BEGIN'
stat -c 'mode=%a owner=%U group=%G type=%F' /etc/cron.allow
nl -ba /etc/cron.allow
printf '%s\n' 'CONFIG_END'
printf 'ALLOW_SHA256='; sha256sum /etc/cron.allow | awk '{print $1}'
printf 'OPSADMIN='; getent passwd opsadmin
printf 'CROND_ACTIVE='; systemctl is-active crond
printf 'CROND_ENABLED='; systemctl is-enabled crond
printf '%s\n' 'OPSADMIN_INSTALL_TEST_BEGIN'
printf '17 3 31 2 * /usr/bin/true\n' | runuser -u opsadmin -- crontab -
runuser -u opsadmin -- crontab -l
runuser -u opsadmin -- crontab -r
if runuser -u opsadmin -- crontab -l >/tmp/opsadmin-post.out 2>&1; then printf 'unexpected_crontab_remains\n'; cat /tmp/opsadmin-post.out; exit 1; else cat /tmp/opsadmin-post.out; fi
rm -f /tmp/opsadmin-post.out
printf '%s\n' 'OPSADMIN_INSTALL_TEST_END'
printf '%s\n' 'DENIED_DAEMON_TEST_BEGIN'
set +e
printf '18 3 31 2 * /usr/bin/true\n' | runuser -u daemon -- crontab - >/tmp/daemon-test.out 2>&1
deny_rc=$?
set -e
cat /tmp/daemon-test.out
rm -f /tmp/daemon-test.out
printf 'DENIED_DAEMON_RC=%s\n' "$deny_rc"
[ "$deny_rc" -ne 0 ]
[ ! -e /var/spool/cron/daemon ]
printf '%s\n' 'DENIED_DAEMON_TEST_END'
printf 'ROOT_ACCESS_PROBE='; if runuser -u root -- crontab -l >/tmp/root-probe.out 2>&1; then printf 'authorized_existing_crontab\n'; else if grep -q 'not allowed' /tmp/root-probe.out; then cat /tmp/root-probe.out; rm -f /tmp/root-probe.out; exit 1; else printf 'authorized_no_crontab\n'; fi; fi
rm -f /tmp/root-probe.out
